# Throughout (PVT) LTD

> Throughout is an offshore software development studio in Colombo, Sri Lanka. We design, build and grow websites, web and mobile apps, MVPs and SaaS platforms, and provide dedicated development teams for founders, agencies and businesses in Australia, Europe and beyond.

Website: https://www.throughout.io
Location: Colombo, Sri Lanka (GMT+5:30, overlapping with Australia, Europe and the Gulf)
Contact: info@throughout.io, WhatsApp +94 76 772 7992, free 30-minute call at https://www.throughout.io/#contact

## Services

- [Software development](https://www.throughout.io/services/engineering): Offshore software development in Sri Lanka. Web and mobile apps, SaaS and MVP builds, Shopify and e-commerce, AI and workflow automation, cloud, DevOps and QA. Stack: Next.js, React, Node.js, NestJS, Laravel, Python.
- [UI/UX and website design](https://www.throughout.io/services/design): UX research, UI/UX design for web and mobile, website and landing page design, prototypes, design systems, brand identity.
- [SEO, GEO and digital marketing](https://www.throughout.io/services/marketing): Technical SEO, schema.org structured data, generative engine optimisation (GEO), llms.txt and AI crawler access, content strategy, Google and Meta ads, conversion optimisation.
- [Dedicated development teams](https://www.throughout.io/#engagement-models): Hire dedicated developers, designers, QA and marketers who work inside your tools and roadmap, or hire a project team for a defined website, app or MVP.

## Work

- [Products we built and run](https://www.throughout.io/#work): Rankout (AI SEO platform, https://rankout.app/), Checkout (offline-first POS), Tryout (custom T-shirt design and printing), Comflo (customer conversations and orders), Spendout (free expense tracker with Gmail receipts).
- [Client projects](https://www.throughout.io/#work): Throughout CRM, Naaraa Biznet, Findout, Montado Coffee, Rataa Backdrops, NRS Optical, Ado Coffee, Hostraspace, Artisans Touch.
- [Case study: Müllwood SEO rebuild](https://www.throughout.io/insights/mullwood-seo-rebuild-case-study): Three months of SEO, AEO and GEO for mullwood.lk. Structured data coverage 0% to 100%, 20 pages and products given SEO titles and keywords, 671 images without alt text fixed, blog grown from 1 to 13 articles.
- [Case study: CoreConnect group SEO](https://www.throughout.io/#seo-case-study-coreconnect): Month 1 of SEO, AEO and GEO across aerixlk.com, airmatelk.com and coreconnect.lk. Aerix URLs with SEO titles and metas 0% to 90%, Airmate pages and products with SEO titles 0 to 61, CoreConnect structured data 0% to 100%, 246 images given alt text.
- [Case study: Comflo retention campaign](https://www.throughout.io/insights/comflo-retention-campaign-case-study): 28.6x return on ad spend in 24 hours. 200 existing customers reached on WhatsApp, LKR 1,400 spent, LKR 40,000+ revenue.
